event.name: Gran Canaria World Cup
event.cover_sub: My top 4 men to make the final in Pozo Izquierdo. Powerful side-shore winds, big jumps and world-class wave riding at one of the most iconic venues on tour.

picks.name: Philip Koster
picks.why: Rumours of a minor injury, but you can {{never rule out Philip in Pozo}}.

picks.name: Marc Pare
picks.why: The 2025 world champion looks on fire in the training diaries, and a strong result here would {{equal his best Gran Canaria finish}}.

picks.name: Marcilio Browne
picks.why: Mr Consistent. After a good result at the Maui Pro, he'll be chasing another here to {{reclaim that world title}}.

picks.label: Pick to Win
picks.name: Marino Gil
picks.why: The Pozo local and 2024 champion is looking on fire and {{hungry for the top spot}} after 2025.
